entities.summary: Julian Schnabel is an American painter and filmmaker. In the 1980s, he received international attention for his "plate paintings"—with broken ceramic plates set onto large-scale paintings. Since the 1990s, he has been a proponent of independent arthouse cinema. Schnabel directed Before Night Falls, which became Javier Bardem's breakthrough Academy Award-nominated role, and The Diving Bell and the Butterfly, which was nominated for four Academy Awards. For the latter, he won the Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Director, as well as the Golden Globe Award for Best Director, and also received nominations for the Academy Award for Best Director and the César Award for Best Director.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent filmmaker, Julian Schnabel's work on 'The Diving Bell and the Butterfly' received four Academy Award nominations and won the Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Director, contributing to his international recognition as a director of critically acclaimed arthouse films.
